usageNotes: Use this endpoint to discover what job-related sub-endpoints are available under /cluster/jobs (e.g., scheduled tasks, realm-sync jobs). It is a navigation index only — it returns directory entries with 'subdir' names, not actual job data. No authentication privileges beyond a valid API token are required.

examples.summary: List available job sub-endpoints on the cluster

tips: The returned 'subdir' values (e.g., 'realm-sync', 'schedule') are the path segments to append to /cluster/jobs/ for actual job operations.
This is a pure discovery call with no side effects; safe to call at any time without impacting cluster state.
